title: Choose Meard composition
question: Three Jacquard compositions for the Meard landing page. Pick one to build, combine ideas, or revise.

options.label: Punch-card canopy hero
options.lineage: Quality-bar sibling: cream hole-grid canopy + silk bird field
options.body: First viewport is a thesis: large gold headline left, woven bird right, punch-card nav top, cream mission strip bottom. Strongest match to the craft bar. Tools and contact live below the fold as loom bands.

options.label: Vertical loom bands
options.body: The whole site is stacked loom rows: cream nav → silk thesis → cream instruction/binary → silk tool cards → gold contact rail. Best for funder storytelling and honest 'no models yet' ledger rows. Slightly denser.

options.label: Split workbench
options.body: Left cream punch ledger of lab truths; right silk with bird and dual CTAs. Tools as woven cards under the split. Excellent for funder scan of facts + action; risk is left column feeling form-like if copy is long.
